title: selaginella pubescens
intro: Selaginella pubescens, commonly known as the hairy spikemoss, is a type of small, non-vascular plant belonging to the Selaginellaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities, which may help in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Selaginella pubescens include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
